content:
ashley: Heads-up — starting base-image rebuild for runtime nodes next Tue 02:00 UTC. Goal: remove legacy packages, rebaseline CVE list, enable FIPS-enabled KMS integrations and cosign signing. Need RBAC changes for image-publisher SA (s3/gcr push). Any blockers?
keith: +1. For RBAC: we need to add iam:PassRole-ish permissions for the signer role? what's the desired flow for KMS key usage — service account impersonation or workload identity?
sasha: CVE triage: I'll run the vuln scan on the new base and post results. Can we add the CVE allowlist to the image build so it fails the job if new criticals appear?
ashley: plan is workload identity to the KMS wrapper (no long-lived creds). RBAC change: image-publisher -> allow kms:Encrypt/Decrypt via signer-role; I'll open PR.
keith: also ensure cosign key rotation path is documented. Example cosign command we want in CI:
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign-key 
--annotations build_sha=$BUILD_SHA gcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha-$BUILD_SHA
```
keith: and add cosign verify step in the deployment pipeline.
devops-bot: pipeline triggered: base-image-rebuild-ci #2076543210 — build started, logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/runtime/builds/2076543210
security-oncall: re RBAC approvals — I'll review the PR but want an OPA gate to block any broad roles. Add this to the policy: no role with "*" permissions on compute/gcr.
maria: runtime secret question — we need ephemeral KMS-wrapped secrets for bootstrapping. Can the init container pull secrets with short-lived tokens? If so, we must add audit logging: who requested key, request ID.
ashley: yes init containers will use workload identity, token lifetime <= 5m. We will wire audit logs to centralized SIEM; audit log event schema in the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/secure-image-cutover
sasha: I'll upload initial vuln report by EOD Monday. If high/critical shows up we'll pause the rebuild.
keith: can we do a canary rollout? do 10% of runtime pool first and run perf+fuzz tests for 30m then escalate.
ashley: yes canary + automatic rollback on health 체크 (health checks + KV cache hit rate + p50 latency). Rollback playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/runtime-image-rollback
sasha: quick note: add SBOM publishing step to artifact storage (cosign + syft).
ashley: thanks — I'll open the RBAC + KMS PRs and tag @security-oncall and @keith. If no blockers by Mon 18:00 UTC we go ahead with the Tuesday window.
keith: ack :thumbsup:
security-oncall: acked. I'll also prepare the audit queries to run after cutover.
maria: I'll prepare the init-container KMS wrapper image and push to staging.
devops-bot: build #2076543210 completed: SUCCESS. artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/base-images/runtime:2076543210-snapshot, sbom https://artifacts.redwood/internal/sbom/2076543210.json
ashley: great — thanks all. I'll post PR links when ready.
